name: Nullframe PalmSync Chrome-Interface Glove
description:
Precision-engineered to bridge organic hand and chrome forearm augmentation. Constructed from gunmetal-grey adaptive syn-neoprene with embedded conductive threading that maps to standard aug-port contact arrays. The glove terminates in a structured cuff with a magnetic locking ring that aligns flush against most mid-grade chrome forearm housings, creating a seamless visual and tactile join.

Finger segments are articulated with micro-flex panels allowing full dexterity. Available in full-finger and half-finger cuts. The dorsal surface features a subtle embossed circuit-trace pattern in matte black — functional, not decorative: it routes haptic return signals from the chrome to surviving nerve clusters.
functionality: Interfaces with standard aug-port arrays on chrome forearms. Haptic relay film transmits tactile feedback from prosthetic fingertips to residual nerve clusters. Magnetic cuff locks to most mid-grade chrome housings. Half-finger variant allows direct digital contact for biometric access points.
what_it_says: You've got chrome and you're not hiding it — you're making it work better than the factory default.
worn_by: prosthetic limb wearers seeking tactile feedback
story_hooks: A glove pulled from a drainage canal still has a partial handprint burned into its haptic film — and the chrome it was paired with is missing from its registered owner.
Nullframe quietly recalled batch 7-C after users reported phantom pain feedback loops; the recall was never publicized and thousands of affected pairs are still in circulation.
A Tier 3 accountant wearing one of these keeps receiving haptic signals that don't correspond to anything their chrome is touching — someone is spoofing the relay frequency.
related_entities: MindBridge Relay One Social Integration BCI

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, form-fitting glove that bridges organic and augmented anatomy with surgical precision. The gunmetal-grey surface catches light along subtle contours, creating an impression of high-end prosthetic integration rather than mere fashion. Worn, it appears as a seamless extension between flesh and chrome — clinical but confident.
physical_description.fit: Compression-fitted through the palm and fingers, with structured rigidity in the cuff section. The glove molds to hand geometry without excess material, allowing full articulation while maintaining contact pressure against augmentation ports.
physical_description.primary_material: Adaptive syn-neoprene with embedded conductive threading; gunmetal-grey finish with matte black accent accents
physical_description.texture: Smooth, slightly tacky neoprene surface with embedded conductive filaments creating a subtle raised grid texture. The dorsal surface features a fine embossed circuit-trace relief pattern that catches light. Cuff section is rigid-edged, magnetic.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal grey base with matte black embossed circuit-trace patterns across the back of the hand and fingers; metallic silver highlights along the cuff magnetic contact ring
physical_description.closures: Magnetic locking ring at the cuff terminus; friction-fit integration with aug-port contact arrays; no traditional closures
distinctive_features: Embossed circuit-trace pattern routing haptic return signals
Magnetic locking ring aligned for mid-grade chrome forearm housing
Conductive threading integrated throughout for port compatibility
Micro-flex articulated panels in finger segments
Structured cuff designed for flush integration with augmentation
Available in full-finger and half-finger variants
Subtle Nullframe Systems branding on inner cuff
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 bridge: street-accessible augmentation accessory with corpo-grade engineering. Not luxury, not salvage — functional precision at mid-market price point
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals active augmentation user; suggests ongoing relationship with chrome modification and street-adjacent tech culture. Worn by techs, modders, working-class aug-users, and corpo field operatives. Denotes practical integration rather than cosmetic display.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to lightly worn; neoprene shows minimal creasing, circuit-trace pattern remains crisp. Magnetic contacts stay bright. Heavy use shows minor scuffing on knuckles and cuff wear from repeated port insertion/removal.
